name: spindev-deploy
description: Deployment-target-specific reference skills for spinlockdevelopment. Ships flyio (fly.io provisioning + always-on app config + day-2 ops, with documented gotchas) and sprites-dev (correct-usage rules for the sprite CLI and sprites.dev API on Windows/Git Bash). Both skills back their rules with PreToolUse Bash hooks (sprite-guard, fly-guard) that catch documented failure modes at execution time. Enable only on projects that deploy to the matching platform.
